title: B.Tech CSE Curriculum 2026-27
text: The objective of CSE101 (Programming Fundamentals) is to develop programming basics, problem-solving ability, and algorithmic thinking.

title: B.Tech CSE Curriculum 2026-27
text: The objective of CSE102 (Data Structures) is to teach core linear and non-linear data structures and their applications.

title: B.Tech CSE Curriculum 2026-27
text: The objective of CSE201 (Object Oriented Programming) is to teach classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, and encapsulation.

title: B.Tech CSE Curriculum 2026-27
text: The objective of CSE202 (Database Management Systems) is to explain database design, SQL, transactions, and normalization.

title: B.Tech CSE Curriculum 2026-27
text: The objective of CSE203 (Operating Systems) is to explain processes, memory management, files, and scheduling.

title: B.Tech CSE Curriculum 2026-27
text: The objective of CSE301 (Computer Networks) is to introduce network models, protocols, addressing, and routing.

title: B.Tech CSE Curriculum 2026-27
text: The objective of CSE302 (Compiler Design) is to explain lexical analysis, parsing, semantic analysis, and code generation.

title: B.Tech CSE Curriculum 2026-27
text: The objective of CSE303 (Machine Learning) is to introduce supervised and unsupervised learning workflows.

title: B.Tech CSE Curriculum 2026-27
text: The objective of CSE401 (Cloud Computing) is to cover cloud service models, deployment concepts, and resource management.

title: B.Tech CSE Curriculum 2026-27
text: The objective of CSE402 (Major Project I) is to guide project problem definition, requirements, design, and implementation.

title: B.Tech CSE Curriculum 2026-27
text: The objective of CSE403 (Major Project II) is to guide project completion, validation, documentation, and final presentation.

title: B.Tech ECE Curriculum 2026-27
text: The objective of ECE101 (Electronic Devices) is to introduce semiconductor devices and electronic components.

title: B.Tech ECE Curriculum 2026-27
text: The objective of ECE201 (Digital Signal Processing) is to teach discrete-time signals, transforms, and digital filters.

title: B.Tech EEE Curriculum 2026-27
text: The objective of EEE201 (Power Systems I) is to introduce generation, transmission, and basic power-system analysis.

title: B.Tech ME Curriculum 2026-27
text: The objective of ME201 (Thermodynamics) is to develop fundamentals of thermodynamic systems, laws, and cycles.
